purpose: Cross-sweep working ledger for Phase 8.4 fall-camp QB monitoring. One row per exception team once a sweep produces a meaningful update. Feeds the next workbook candidate (v0.7.3+) only when >=5 teams have cleared uncertainty or at the final Aug 24-26 sweep. Compact fields only - no narrative summaries.
status: EMPTY - no resolutions yet. No research performed today (2026-07-22). First sweep window: 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-05.

field_documentation.sweep_date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD of the sweep on which this row was recorded.
field_documentation.current_leader: Named/leading QB, or blank if genuinely undecided.
field_documentation.confidence: H / M / L per the Phase 8.4 resolution standards.
field_documentation.source: Best credible source per the source-efficiency order.
field_documentation.source_date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD of the source; blank if the exact date is unavailable (do not invent).
field_documentation.baseline_identity: The preseason baseline QB the rating priced in (established / not established).
field_documentation.zero_init_justified: Y if resolved Active QB == baseline and no unresolved issue (-> D=0/F=0, status OK). N otherwise.
field_documentation.nonzero_adjustment_possible: Y if the resolved Active QB differs materially from baseline (-> add to qb_deviation_review_log, PROPOSE a quarter-point deviation, leave row UNCERTAIN pending approval). N otherwise.

rules: Record a row only on a meaningful update; do not re-research resolved teams or the other 105 unless credible news reports a starter change, injury, suspension, eligibility issue, or departure.
zero_init_justified=Y is applied to the workbook only when building the next candidate (>=5 cleared or final sweep).
nonzero_adjustment_possible=Y NEVER writes a value; it routes to qb_deviation_review_log with a PROPOSED quarter-point deviation and the row stays UNCERTAIN until explicit approval.
Injury cases require credible evidence of normal participation or confirmed game availability before clearing; 'expected back' is not sufficient.
